_comment: Planet size is N/(H/2) half-heights: 128 today, 832 Earth analogue, at most 1024. Use multiples of 32 so coarsest chunks tile every face. N must also fit 2^20 columns (sim::PosKey). World height H is a power of two; sea_level = H/2. vertical_scale null follows R / 6,371,000 m (Earth slopes). roughness and landform are terrain dials. CLI --planet-size uses half-heights; --n overrides raw columns for tests.
name: Neisor
